description: This file defines the FooTable.Columns class, which manages column handling, parsing, initialization, drawing, and destruction within the FooTable plugin. It includes methods for parsing column data from DOM or options, finalizing column creation, and managing column visibility based on breakpoints.

classes.name: F.Columns
classes.description: Class managing the columns component of FooTable, including parsing, initialization, rendering, and destruction of table columns.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the columns component with the parent table, setting up options, and determining if columns are from HTML.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses column definitions from DOM or options, merging them and finalizing column creation.

methods.name: parseFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes column creation from merged definitions, creating column objects and resolving or rejecting the deferred.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Pre-initialization method that raises an event and parses column options before UI creation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the columns component, creating the header row and raising an event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the columns component, removing UI elements if not from HTML.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Pre-draw step that determines column visibility based on breakpoints.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of columns, hiding or showing them based on visibility.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the header row element from column definitions and appends it to the table.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a column by instance, name, index, or a callback function.

methods.name: ensure
methods.description: Ensures an array of columns from names, indices, or column instances.
